claims.text: POGO is donor-funded, publishes audited financials and holds four-star Charity Navigator, CharityWatch and Candid Platinum transparency ratings; it produces investigative reports, policy recommendations and congressional testimony, and maintains published whistleblower resources.

POGO is a nonpartisan independent watchdog founded in 1981, initially as a Pentagon watchdog, later expanded to monitor the entire federal government; it self-describes its mission as investigating and exposing systemic corruption, abuse of power and waste.
